name: Taltson Critical Minerals Corp.
summary: Taltson Critical Minerals Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral property assets in Canada. The company explores for zinc, lead, copper, and silver. It holds a 100% interest in the O'Connor Lake property located in the South Slave region of the Northwest Territories. The company was formerly known as Slave Lake Zinc Corp. and changed its name to Taltson Critical Minerals Corp. in August 2026. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Chilliwack, Canada.
